merger_description:
ACURIO Health Pty Ltd (**Acurio**) proposes to acquire three private hospitals located in the greater Sydney area from Healthscope Operations Pty Ltd (**Healthscope**) (the **Acquisition**). The three private hospitals that are the subject of the Acquisition are:

* Nepean Private Hospital in Kingswood;
* Sydney Southwest Private Hospital in Liverpool; and
* Campbelltown Private Hospital in Campbelltown.

The Acquisition forms part of a broader consortium acquisition of Healthscope's portfolio. The other consortium members are Calvary, Healthe Care and KnG Group, which will each acquire separate hospitals pursuant to inter-conditional sale agreements.

Acurio is a private hospital operator, which currently operates The George Centre in the Gledswood Hills and Sydney Day Hospital in the Sydney central business district. The George Centre is a 61-bed private hospital offering overnight accommodation. It offers maternity and paediatric services, with a 26-bed private maternity unit, as well as a range of other surgical services. Sydney Day Hospital is a day surgery which does not offer overnight accommodation.

Healthscope operates a network of private hospitals across Australia. On 26 May 2025, Healthscope's parent entities entered into receivership, with McGrathNicol appointed as Receivers to complete a sale of the business. The Receivers conducted an extended sale process over Healthscope's hospital portfolio.
